title: Equinox Pharma - Procurement review (MSA / DPA / SLAs / Pricing)
summary: Procurement/Legal review covering MSA and DPA open items, SLAs and uptime, pricing approvals for Dedicated vs Hosted, security controls (SOC 2, KMS, SSO), and next steps to circulate redlines and schedule final pricing sign-off.
topics: pricing for dedicated capacity vs hosted
transcript: 00:00 Jordan: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, this is Jordan from Redwood Inference, i have Priya our solutions engineer and Liam from customer success. 00:07 Mark: Thanks, Jordan. we have Sara from legal, Andre from procurement, Nina our security lead, and Diego from DevOps. 00:15 Jordan: Great, quick agenda - go through the MSA redlines Sara sent, DPA, SLAs, pricing questions, and then action items. 00:28 Sara: Quick note, legal flagged three major items in the MSA - data ownership, indemnity caps, and audit rights. we want to be clear on data deletion windows. 00:40 Priya: Understood. On deletion we support configurable retention per-tenant and can confirm deletion upon contract termination. on Private deployments we can also provide physical on-prem install. 00:52 Nina: Do you offer BYOK with HSM or just KMS? we need FIPS 140-2 compatibility. 01:02 Priya: Yes we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations and HSM in our Private package; we can provide the KMS key rotation policy docs. 01:15 Andre: On pricing, procurement needs the difference between hosted API costs and dedicated reserved capacity — can we get a weekly token projection and cost delta? 01:27 Jordan: We'll send a pricing sheet. For dedicated, you get predictable throughput and a monthly commit; Hosted is usage-based. we can run a small POC to measure token usage. 01:40 Diego: Technical question - when you say dedicated, is the KV cache isolated per customer or shared? 01:47 Priya: For Dedicated it's isolated, with per-tenant KV cache and network isolation in a VPC; for hosted we do logical isolation. 01:58 Sara: Back to indemnity - our standard is mutual cap tied to fees over 12 months; your legal suggested something different. can that be adjusted? 02:09 Jordan: I will follow up with legal. We typically push for a higher cap but can align on mutual language; Jordan: (overlap) — sorry, will sync off-line with contracts. 02:20 Nina: Also requirement for SOC 2 Type II and ISO27001 evidence — can you provide your latest reports and penetration test summary? 02:30 Priya: Yes, SOC 2 report is available under NDA; we can provide an attestation and a redacted pen-test summary. 02:40 Andre: Procurement timeline - we need final pricing approved by next Wednesday to hit our Q2 launch. 02:47 Jordan: Noted. We'll aim to get the MSA/DPA redlines responded to in 3 business days and pricing by Monday. 02:58 Sara: DPA question - data residency: some PHI workloads need EU residency. does Redwood's Private support EU on-prem or region pinning? 03:10 Priya: We can pin to EU regions for hosted, and Private on-prem or VPC deployments in EU are supported; we'll detail the options in writing. 03:22 Mark: Can you confirm encryption at rest and in transit? and retention of logs? 03:30 Priya: TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest; logs can be set to X days retention per agreement and audit logs exported to customer SIEM via syslog. 03:44 Diego: Onboarding - what's the typical ramp for dedicated? time-to-first-test? 03:50 Liam: Typical onboarding for Dedicated is 4-6 weeks, includes infra provisioning, model onboarding, and performance tuning, shorter for hosted. 04:02 Sara: There's a clause about subprocessor list in the DPA - we need an up-to-date list and notification timing on new subprocessors. 04:12 Priya: We'll attach our current subprocessors and the typical 30-day notice timeline; we can also offer a 60-day notice if required by contract. 04:25 Andre: Are there exit terms for data export at termination? we want machine-readable exports within 30 days. 04:34 Priya: Yes, we support full data export in JSON/NDJSON and will keep an export window of 30 days post-termination by default, subject to DPA. 04:45 Sara: Also want indemnity carve-outs for customer data breaches due to Redwood negligence. 04:52 Jordan: We'll ask legal to propose precise language; high level yes but need to align on scoping. 05:00 Nina: Can you support SAML SSO and RBAC for users? we need SCIM and SSO. 05:08 Priya: Yes SAML SSO supported, SCIM provisioning available on Dedicated and Enterprise plans, RBAC with role mappings. 05:18 Mark: Performance SLA - we care about p95 latency under 300ms for embedding calls; is that realistic? 05:27 Priya: For embeddings at typical payloads we can hit p95 under 200ms in Dedicated with right instance types; Hosted depends on traffic but we have latency SLO tiers. 05:40 Andre: On pricing approvals, can you provide a 12-month committed price for a 4-GPU pool and an alternative metered hosted estimate for our expected 3M tokens/month? 05:53 Jordan: We'll produce both scenarios. Also note a discount tier for annual commit. 06:02 Sara: Legal asked for mutual audit rights limited to security posture only, not source code or proprietary ops. 06:12 Priya: That's standard; we can scope audit to security controls, logs, configuration, and redacted operational docs. 06:22 Diego: Integration question - do you have terraform modules or helm charts for Private deployments? 06:30 Priya: We provide Terraform modules and helm charts, plus an ansible playbook if needed. 06:38 Andre: Competitors asked in RFP include MegaCloudAI and CloudPrompt - do you have differentiation notes we can include? 06:48 Jordan: We'll share an ROI doc and benchmarking spreadsheet showing cost per token and latency. 06:56 Sara: We may push a couple of redlines — can we expect an editable MSA in Word with track changes? 07:03 Jordan: Yes, we'll send a Word copy and accept track changes, prefer to iterate in parallel. 07:12 Nina: Any SOC2 exceptions? we need to know if you have subservice provider gaps. 07:19 Priya: We'll provide the SOC2 and call out known exceptions; none material for our typical deployments. 07:28 Mark: Ok let's talk timeline - procurement decision by April 9, legal signoff April 1, onboarding to start mid-April if approved. 07:37 Jordan: Sounds good. Recap next steps and owners? 07:44 Liam: I'll capture the onboarding checklist and send the link to the shared folder. 07:50 Jordan: Great, thanks everyone. we'll follow up with the MSA/DPA responses, pricing scenarios, SOC2 docs, and deployment runbook. 07:58 Sara: Thank you. 08:01 End of recording.
